file name: adal4j-1.6.7.jar The issue is not in the jar but with Azure Active Directory: An information disclosure vulnerability manifests when a user or an application uploads unprotected private key data as part of an authentication certificate keyCredential on an Azure AD Application or Service Principal (which is not recommended).
file name: google-http-client-gson-1.41.7.jar False positive as there is no issue in google-http-client-gson but in com.google.code.gson:gson < 2.8.9

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

CVE-2025-53864 affects Nimbus JOSE+JWT before 10.0.2, including 9.47 and 9.48. The 9.37.4 backport fixes the older 9.37 branch but would downgrade the current 9.47 dependency; no non-downgrading stable 9.x fix is published. A 10.x upgrade is deferred pending investigation of the existing cross-repository major-version conflict. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xwmg-2g98-w7v9 https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/nimbusds/nimbus-jose-jwt/maven-metadata.xml The scanner attaches this Nimbus finding to its embedded Gson 2.11.0 metadata. Upgrading the external Gson dependency cannot replace shaded classes inside Nimbus. This suppression matches only that exact embedded dependency, not Gson generally. Deeply nested untrusted JWT claim sets can still cause uncontrolled recursion and denial of service; this remains an accepted risk, not a remediated vulnerability.
